description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ConfigService component in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various getter and setter methods, configuration behaviors, and exception handling of the ConfigService class, utilizing mocks for dependencies like ConfigDao.

classes.name: ConfigServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ConfigService, testing configuration retrieval and setting methods, as well as exception handling and dependency injection.
